data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) central interactions.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to act as a BLE central device to scan for, connect to, and interact with peripheral devices. It supports reading/writing characteristics, subscriptions, bonding process observation, and connection management.
use_when: Your app needs to scan for and connect to nearby Bluetooth Low Energy peripherals.
You need to read, write, or subscribe to BLE characteristics from Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need high-level device information or general connectivity checks without BLE.
Your app needs to act exclusively as a BLE peripheral rather than a central (though background accessory capabilities exist).
strengths: Comprehensive suite of BLE operations including scanning, connecting, bonding, and characteristic management.
Built-in testing support including a FakeCentralMethodChannel and ESP32 hardware integration testing.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions for Android, iOS, and macOS.
Limited to BLE central role interactions primarily.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding BLE permissions and features to AndroidManifest.xml, and Info.plist usage descriptions and Background Modes capabilities for iOS/macOS.
